answer: LIST z, l, round(a, 2) FROM Site has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO is of Scan has Project is of Scanpointcloud pc AND ALSO pc has Length r AND ALSO pc has ScanpointcloudPointdense pd AND ALSO pc has coverpct Percentage cp AND ALSO pc has lappct Percentage lp AND ALSO pc has ScanpointcloudNoisedb nd AND ALSO (power(10 / (log10(r * 1000) / log10(pd) * 5), 1.5) * (cp * (1 + lp / 100 * (1 - cp / 100)) / 100) * power(1 - nd / 30, 2)) AS sqs AND ALSO THE AVERAGE sqs GROUPED BY z, l AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING

LIST z, l, ss, ps, cat FROM Site has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO has SitePresstat ps AND ALSO is of Scanconservation has ScanconservationStructstate ss AND ALSO if((contains(ps, 'Poor') OR contains(ps, 'Critical')) AND NOT contains(ss, 'Stable'), 'Degradation Risk Zone', 'Not in Risk Zone') AS cat

LIST z, l, round(a, 2) FROM Scanenvironment has Site s AND ALSO s has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO s has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO has ScanenvironmentAmbictemp t AND ALSO has Percentage h AND ALSO has ScanenvironmentIllumelux i AND ALSO (100 - 2.5 * abs(t - 20) - power(abs((h - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / (i + 100)) AS esi AND ALSO THE AVERAGE esi GROUPED BY z, l AS a

LIST rid, pid, la, ev, round(rar, 2), conf FROM Scanregistration has ScanregistrationLogRegistry rid AND ALSO has Project p AND ALSO p has ProjectArcregistry pid AND ALSO has logaccumm Length la AND ALSO has errorvalue Length ev AND ALSO has ScanregistrationLogmethod m AND ALSO p is of Scanpointcloud has Length res AND ALSO (res / (la * sqrt(1 + ev / la))) AS rar AND ALSO if(rar > 1.5 AND contains(m, 'Target'), 'High Confidence', if(rar >= 1.0, 'Medium Confidence', 'Low Confidence')) AS conf

LIST z, l, round(a, 2) FROM Site s has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO is of Scan has Project pj AND ALSO pj is of Scanpointcloud pc AND ALSO pc has Length res AND ALSO pc has ScanpointcloudPointdense pd AND ALSO pc has coverpct Percentage cp AND ALSO pc has lappct Percentage lp AND ALSO pc has ScanpointcloudNoisedb nd AND ALSO pj is of Scanregistration rg AND ALSO rg has logaccumm Length la AND ALSO rg has errorvalue Length ev AND ALSO s is of Scanmesh mh AND ALSO mh has ScanmeshFacetfaces ff AND ALSO mh has ScanmeshFacetverts fv AND ALSO mh has facetresmm Length fr AND ALSO mh has geomdeltamm Length gd AND ALSO mh has ScanmeshTexpix tx AND ALSO (cp * (1 + lp / 100 * (1 - cp / 100))) AS sce AND ALSO (log10(res * 1000) / log10(pd) * 5) AS sri AND ALSO (power(10 / sri, 1.5) * (sce / 100) * power(1 - nd / 30, 2)) AS sqs AND ALSO (ff / (fv * fr * fr) * 1000) AS mcr AND ALSO (tx / (sqrt(ff) * fr) / 100) AS tdi AND ALSO (mcr * (tdi / 10) * (1 + exp(0 - gd))) AS mfs AND ALSO (sqs * 0.4 + mfs * 0.4 + sce * 0.2 - 5 * sqrt(nd / 10)) AS adc AND ALSO (res / (la * sqrt(1 + ev / la))) AS rar AND ALSO (0.3 * adc + 0.3 * mfs + 0.2 * rar + 0.2 * sce - 2 * sqrt(ev / res)) AS dpq AND ALSO THE AVERAGE dpq GROUPED BY z, l AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING

LIST z, l, tot, hf, round(pct, 2), round(amcr, 2), round(ares, 2), round(ageo, 2), cls FROM Site s has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO OPTIONALLY is of Scanmesh m AND ALSO m OPTIONALLY has ScanmeshFacetfaces ff AND ALSO m OPTIONALLY has ScanmeshFacetverts fv AND ALSO m OPTIONALLY has facetresmm Length fr AND ALSO m OPTIONALLY has geomdeltamm Length gd AND ALSO (ff / (fv * fr * fr) * 1000) AS mcr AND ALSO if(mcr > 5.0 AND fr < 1.0 AND gd < 0.5, 1, 0) AS ishf AND ALSO THE COUNT OF m GROUPED BY z, l AS tot AND ALSO THE SUM OF ishf GROUPED BY z, l AS hf AND ALSO THE AVERAGE mcr GROUPED BY z, l AS amcr AND ALSO THE AVERAGE fr GROUPED BY z, l AS ares AND ALSO THE AVERAGE gd GROUPED BY z, l AS ageo AND ALSO (hf * 100.0 / tot) AS pct AND ALSO if(hf > 0, 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes', if(tot > 0, 'Standard Mesh Quality', 'No Mesh Data')) AS cls ORDERED WITH pct DESCENDING

DEFINE EnvAvg ::= LIST s, at, ah, ai, ae FROM Scanenvironment has Site s AND ALSO has ScanenvironmentAmbictemp t AND ALSO has Percentage h AND ALSO has ScanenvironmentIllumelux i AND ALSO (100 - 2.5 * abs(t - 20) - power(abs((h - 50) / 2), 1.5) - 600 / (i + 100)) AS esi AND ALSO THE AVERAGE t GROUPED BY s AS at AND ALSO THE AVERAGE h GROUPED BY s AS ah AND ALSO THE AVERAGE i GROUPED BY s AS ai AND ALSO THE AVERAGE esi GROUPED BY s AS ae
LIST z, l, round(at, 1), round(ah, 1), round(ai, 1), round(a, 1), tile, cls FROM Site s has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO has SiteZoneLabel l AND ALSO has EnvAvg EnvAvgAt at AND ALSO has ah EnvAvgAh ah AND ALSO has ai EnvAvgAi ai AND ALSO has ae EnvAvgAe a AND ALSO 1 AS one AND ALSO THE RANK OF a WITHIN one AS rk AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s WITHIN one AS n AND ALSO (n + 1 - rk) AS r AND ALSO div(n, 4) AS q AND ALSO (n - 4 * div(n, 4)) AS rem AND ALSO (rem * (div(n, 4) + 1)) AS b AND ALSO if(r <= b, div(r - 1, q + 1) + 1, rem + div(r - b - 1, q) + 1) AS tile AND ALSO if(a > 85, 'Optimal Scanning Conditions', if(a >= 70, 'Good Scanning Conditions', if(a >= 50, 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions', 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'))) AS cls

LIST fs, fst, round(ah, 1), round(ac, 0), round(ag, 0), round(agb, 1), round(ap, 1), status, n FROM Scanprocessing p has ScanprocessingFlowsoft fs AND ALSO has ScanprocessingFlowStage fst AND ALSO has ScanprocessingFlow fh AND ALSO has ScanprocessingProccpu cpu AND ALSO has ScanprocessingProcgpu gpu AND ALSO has Site is of Scan sc AND ALSO sc has ScanGbsize gb AND ALSO sc has Project is of Scanpointcloud has ScanpointcloudTotalpts tp AND ALSO (gb * log10(tp) / (fh * (cpu + gpu) / 200)) AS per AND ALSO THE AVERAGE fh GROUPED BY fs, fst AS ah AND ALSO THE AVERAGE cpu GROUPED BY fs, fst AS ac AND ALSO THE AVERAGE gpu GROUPED BY fs, fst AS ag AND ALSO THE AVERAGE gb GROUPED BY fs, fst AS agb AND ALSO THE AVERAGE per GROUPED BY fs, fst AS ap AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p GROUPED BY fs, fst AS n AND ALSO if(ap < 0.5, 'Bottleneck Detected', 'Efficient') AS status ORDERED WITH status ASCENDING, ap ASCENDING

LIST z, round(a, 2), round(b, 2) FROM Site s has SiteZoneRegistry z AND ALSO OPTIONALLY is of Scan sc AND ALSO sc OPTIONALLY has Project pj AND ALSO pj OPTIONALLY is of Scanpointcloud pc AND ALSO pc OPTIONALLY has ScanpointcloudTotalpts tp AND ALSO pc OPTIONALLY has ScanpointcloudClouddense cd AND ALSO pj OPTIONALLY is of Scanspatial OPTIONALLY has ScanspatialAream2 ar AND ALSO s OPTIONALLY is of Scanfeature ft AND ALSO ft OPTIONALLY has ScanfeatureTraitcount tc AND ALSO ft OPTIONALLY has ScanfeatureArticount ac AND ALSO (tp / (cd * ar)) AS pcdr AND ALSO ((tc + ac) / (pcdr * sqrt(cd)) * 1000) AS fee AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pcdr GROUPED BY z AS a AND ALSO THE AVERAGE fee GROUPED BY z AS b ORDERED WITH b DESCENDING

DEFINE EqPru ::= LIST e, ap FROM Equipment e is of Scanprocessing pr AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingFlow fh AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingProccpu cpu AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingProcgpu gpu AND ALSO pr has Site is of Scan sc AND ALSO sc has ScanGbsize gb AND ALSO e is of Scanmesh has ScanmeshFacetverts fv AND ALSO (fh * (cpu + gpu) / 2 / (gb * 10 * log10(fv + 10000))) AS pru AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pru GROUPED BY e AS ap
DEFINE EqProc ::= LIST e, ah, ac, ag FROM Equipment e is of Scanprocessing pr AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingFlow h AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingProccpu c AND ALSO pr has ScanprocessingProcgpu g AND ALSO THE AVERAGE h GROUPED BY e AS ah AND ALSO THE AVERAGE c GROUPED BY e AS ac AND ALSO THE AVERAGE g GROUPED BY e AS ag
LIST er, round(a, 2), hh, rk, status, details FROM Equipment e has EquipmentEquipmentRegistry er AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has EqPru EqPruAp a AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has EqProc EqProcAh hh AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ac EqProcAc cc AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ag EqProcAg gg AND ALSO 1 AS one AND ALSO THE RANK OF (0 - coalesce(a, -1e15)) WITHIN one AS rk AND ALSO if(a < 5, 'Optimized', if(a <= 10, 'Acceptable', 'Needs Optimization')) AS status AND ALSO concat('{"cpu_usage":', cc, ',"gpu_usage":', gg, ',"processing_hours":', hh, '}') AS details ORDERED WITH a ASCENDING
